name: Sweet Potato Waffles with Bacon
desc: Savory shredded sweet potato and bacon waffles, topped with fried eggs and scallions.

source.title: Savory Bacon Sweet Potato Waffles {Paleo, Whole30}
source.evidence: Ingredient lines and method match Paleo Running Momma's recipe card word for word; the same recipe also runs on Jones Dairy Farm's site as a sponsored post.

ingredients.raw: 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and shredded
5 slices sugar-free hickory-smoked bacon (the creator uses Jones Dairy Farm)
ingredients.note: the creator uses Jones Dairy Farm

ingredients.raw: 3 scallions, white and green parts separated
1 tbsp rendered bacon fat or other cooking fat, for the waffle iron
ingredients.item: rendered bacon fat or other cooking fat

ingredients.raw: Crushed red pepper flakes, for serving

steps: Shred the sweet potatoes in a food processor or on a box grater. Spread on paper towels and squeeze out as much moisture as you can, then put them in a large bowl.
Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat until crisp, drain on paper towels, and crumble. Save the fat for the waffle iron.

Add the crumbled bacon, eggs, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder to the sweet potatoes. Finely chop the scallion whites and add them; slice the greens and set aside for garnish. Mix well into a thick batter.
Preheat the waffle iron and brush it with bacon fat.
Add enough batter to fill the iron (an 8-inch round iron takes about one third of the mixture) and close the lid. Cook until deep golden brown and crisp on the outside.
Release the waffle carefully and repeat with the remaining batter, brushing the iron with fat each time. Fry the eggs and cook any extra bacon while the waffles cook.
Top each waffle with a fried egg, crumbled bacon, sliced scallion greens, and crushed red pepper.
tips: These take longer than flour waffles; leave the lid closed until the outside is deeply browned or the waffle will tear when you open it.
